title: Filtered vendor fetch silently capped at 100 records with no warning — `limit: 100` hardcoded when any filter active; orgs with >100 vendors get silent false negatives; violates A.5.22
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/vendor-management/VendorRegistry.jsx`
**Root Cause:** `limit: 100` hardcoded when any filter is active. Organisations with more than 100 vendors matching a filter get silent false negatives — the UI shows no indication the results are truncated.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
Replace hardcoded limit with server-side pagination: `const { data, total } = await api.get('/vendors', { params: { ...filters, page, pageSize: 50 } })`. Display: `Showing {pageSize * (page-1) + 1}–{Math.min(pageSize * page, total)} of {total} vendors`. Add pagination controls. Remove the silent `limit: 100` cap.

title: Registry table missing NDA/DPA status, last assessment date, and contract value columns — bulk compliance reviews require per-row drawer opens
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/vendor-management/VendorRegistry.jsx`
**Root Cause:** Registry table lacks NDA/DPA status, last assessment date, and contract value columns. Compliance reviews require opening each vendor's drawer individually to find this information.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
Add optional columns (user-configurable via column picker): `NDA Status` (badge), `DPA Status` (badge), `Last Assessment` (relative date), `Contract Value` (formatted currency), `Next Review Due` (date + overdue flag). Add `<ColumnPicker>` component to allow users to show/hide columns and persist preference in localStorage.

title: Evidence stats count current page only — `calculateStats(evidence)` over page slice; server `statusCounts` aggregation ignored; 'Needs Revision: 3' may mean 47 total
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/vendor-management/EvidenceVault.jsx`
**Root Cause:** `calculateStats(evidence)` operates on the current page slice. Server-side `statusCounts` aggregation is returned by the API but ignored. "Needs Revision: 3" may represent 47 total across all pages.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
Replace `calculateStats(evidence)` with the server-side aggregation: `const stats = apiResponse.statusCounts || {}`. Update stats display: `<StatCard label="Needs Revision" value={stats.needs_revision || 0} total={stats.total} />`. Remove the client-side `calculateStats` function entirely.

title: Trust Network sharing level change requires no second-person authorisation — any user can change to 'full' sharing with no confirmation, approver, or notification to compliance officer; violates A.5.12/A.5.13
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/vendor-management/TrustNetworkSettings.jsx`
**Root Cause:** Any user with vendor access can change the sharing level to `full` with no confirmation dialog, no second approver, and no notification to the compliance officer.
**Impact:** ISO 27001 Annex A 5.12/5.13 require information classification controls. Accidental or unauthorised escalation to 'full' sharing exposes all vendor data to all Trust Network partners.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
Add AlertDialog: `<AlertDialog><AlertDialogContent><AlertDialogTitle>Escalate sharing to Full?</AlertDialogTitle><AlertDialogDescription>All {partnerCount} Trust Network partner(s) will have access to this vendor's complete profile. This action will be logged.</AlertDialogDescription><AlertDialogAction onClick={confirmEscalate}>Confirm Escalation</AlertDialogAction></AlertDialogContent></AlertDialog>`. Notify compliance officer role on escalation.

title: Access log omits sharing level in effect at time of partner access — after a downgrade, prior log gives no evidence of what data was visible; violates A.8.15/A.5.12
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/vendor-management/AccessLogTab.jsx`, `vendor-service/`
**Root Cause:** Access log records the access event but not the `sharingLevel` that was active at the time. After a downgrade from 'full' to 'basic', prior log entries give no evidence of what data was visible.
**Impact:** ISO 27001 Annex A 8.15/5.12 require complete access audit trails. Without the sharing level snapshot, it is impossible to reconstruct what data each partner accessed.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
Backend: snapshot `sharingLevel` at access time: `AccessLog.create({ vendorId, partnerId, accessedAt, sharingLevelAtAccess: vendor.trustNetworkSharingLevel, resourcesAccessed: [] })`. Frontend `AccessLogTab`: add `Sharing Level` column showing the level in effect at the time of each access.

title: Magic link passcode has no visible expiry date and no revoke action — passcode Badge has no expiry display; no 'Revoke Link' button; users perceive access tokens as indefinitely valid; violates A.5.19/A.9.2
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/vendor-management/TrustNetworkSettings.jsx`
**Root Cause:** Passcode Badge shows only the passcode value. No expiry date displayed. No 'Revoke Link' button. Users perceive the token as indefinitely valid.
**Impact:** ISO 27001 Annex A 5.19/9.2 require managed access tokens. An unrevoked vendor portal link remains usable indefinitely, allowing access by former vendor contacts after contract termination.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
Display expiry: `<Badge variant="outline">{passcode} · Expires {formatDate(passcodeExpiry)}</Badge>`. Add `<Button variant="destructive" size="sm" onClick={revokePasscode}><Trash2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />Revoke</Button>`. Backend: `DELETE /vendors/:id/passcode` — set `passcode: null, passcodeExpiry: null` and log the revocation.

title: SharedVaultTab shows no evidence expiry date or current review status to partners — partners see shared evidence with no indication if expired or under revision; false confidence in stale documents
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/vendor-management/SharedVaultTab.jsx`
**Root Cause:** Partners see evidence items with name and upload date only. No expiry date, no current review status (e.g., `needs_revision`). Partners may rely on expired or revised evidence without knowing.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
In `SharedVaultTab` evidence row: `{evidence.expiryDate && <Badge variant={isPast(evidence.expiryDate) ? 'destructive' : 'outline'}>{isPast(evidence.expiryDate) ? 'Expired' : \`Expires \${formatDate(evidence.expiryDate)}\`}</Badge>}`. `{evidence.status === 'needs_revision' && <Badge variant="warning">Under Revision</Badge>}`.

title: Entitlement Mapping tab disabled — `'HIDDEN: Entitlement Mapping temporarily disabled'`; no placeholder shown; vendor access rights undocumentable via platform; violates A.8.2/A.5.19
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/vendor-management/VendorProfile.jsx` **Root Cause:** `'HIDDEN: Entitlement Mapping temporarily disabled'` comment in the tab config. No placeholder tab shown. Vendor access rights cannot be documented via the platform. **Impact:** ISO 27001 Annex A 8.2 requires management of privileged access. Annex A 5.19 requires supplier access to be documented. Without entitlement mapping, access rights are untracked. **Claude Fix Prompt:** Show a placeholder tab: `{ label: 'Entitlement Mapping', icon: Key, content: (

Entitlement Mapping

Track vendor system access rights. Coming soon.

) }`.

title: Questionnaire templates published publicly without approval step — `isPublic` toggle immediately publishes; questions with incorrect legal/compliance mappings can reach all Trust Network orgs
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/vendor-management/TemplateBuilder.jsx`
**Root Cause:** `isPublic` toggle immediately publishes the template to all Trust Network organisations. No review or approval step. Questions with incorrect legal/compliance mappings reach all partners.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
Add two-step publish: Change `isPublic` toggle to set `status: 'pending_review'`. Add a `ReviewTemplateModal` for template managers (role: `vendor.template_approver`) with Accept/Reject actions. Only `status: 'approved'` templates are visible to Trust Network partners. Display status badge in template list: `<Badge>{template.status}</Badge>`.

title: Template version free-text with no auto-increment; assessments lack template version reference — version defaults to '1.0'; historical assessments indistinguishable across template revisions; violates A.5.19/A.5.22
description:
**Files:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/vendor-management/TemplateBuilder.jsx`
**Root Cause:** `version` field defaults to `'1.0'` and accepts free-text. Assessments store no template version reference. Historical assessments completed against different template versions are indistinguishable.
**Claude Fix Prompt:**
Auto-increment version on save: `const nextVersion = incrementSemver(currentTemplate.version); setVersion(nextVersion);`. Make version field read-only (display only). Store `templateVersion` on each assessment at creation: `assessment.templateVersion = template.version; assessment.templateId = template._id;`. Add template version column to assessment history view.
